data.title: bn-10mth: intent.lock mints a successor only from an accepted head; accept decides revisions before signing (RFC 0037 c22)

data.body: [HIGH][CWE-863][risk:high] respects_predecessor checks fifteen protected field bodies and policy verbs, but it never compares policy_reviewers. This new accept path trusts that helper before it signs or writes the revision. A revision that changes only reviewer principals therefore passes and becomes the accepted head. policy_reviewers is identity-bearing governance content at crates/continuum-intent/src/contract.rs:1279-1280,1412-1415,1757-1760. The verified-bundle path at intent.rs:978-1006 uses the same helper, so cross-registry revisions also admit this change. This creates a two-step reviewer-injection path. A later reviewer-gated revision can use the injected principal instead of the predecessor reviewer. Require exact reviewer-map equality, or an explicit fail-closed amendment rule that uses predecessor reviewers, until semantic classification handles meta-governance. Failure modes: replace, remove, or add reviewer principals without predecessor authorization, then use the changed head for a later protected revision. Edge cases: absent versus empty maps, dormant reviewer entries, principal swaps, simultaneous policy tightening, local revisions, and signed bundle revisions. Rollback: do not promote this range. Keep revision acceptance unavailable, or reject reviewer-map changes until a reviewed amendment rule exists. Monitoring: alert whenever an accepted revision changes policy_reviewers, and retain the predecessor and successor identities in audit evidence. Validation: add local and verified-bundle tests for reviewer-only revisions. Assert typed refusal, unchanged registry state, and unchanged controls. Static review did not run tests under the metadata-only contract. The separate risk:critical human-approval gate remains required.

data.reason: Unresolved HIGH CWE-863 governance bypass: revision acceptance does not compare predecessor policy_reviewers, so reviewer-only changes can become the accepted head. See the intent.rs:355 review thread. Static BLOCK preserves the separate risk:critical human-approval gate.

Failure modes, edge cases, rollback, monitoring, and static validation are recorded in th-3vqifv. No remaining security blocker found. Static metadata-only review did not run tests. This vote does not satisfy the separate risk:critical human-approval gate.

data.body: [RESOLVED][risk:high] Target 9591970cdd7aec77f8fa8323f78b2d28ab52cc7b adds exact PolicyReviewers equality at crates/continuumd/src/daemon/intent.rs:1097-1100. The shared predicate gates local and bundle accept at intent.rs:352-356, import at intent.rs:994-1010, and lock at intent.rs:563-567 before registry mutation. Tests at crates/continuumd/tests/daemon_operations.rs:1458-1529 and crates/continuumd/tests/daemon_signing.rs:1615-1726 cover local, imported, and verified-bundle paths with unchanged-state assertions. Failure modes: reviewer replacement, addition, removal, dormant injection, and tightening-plus-injection now return IntentMutationDenied. Edge cases: absent and empty maps normalize to one value, held imported proposals still reach the accept guard, and unchanged reviewer maps still allow policy tightening. Rollback: keep this target unpromoted if this equality guard is removed, and restore only the last accepted source through normal recovery. Monitoring: alert on accepted revisions whose reviewer map differs from its predecessor and on unexpected acceptance after IntentMutationDenied. Validation: I inspected the full persisted range and supporting identity, capability, import, and signature paths. Focused tests exist but were not run under the metadata-only contract. No static blocker remains. The separate risk:critical human-approval gate remains required.
